        row_terminal = [int(c) for c in M_str]
        col_terminal = [int(c) for c in N_str]

        for j in range(1, M + 1):
            dp[0][j] = row_terminal[j - 1]
        for i in range(1, N + 1):

                if i == 0 or j == 0:
                    continue
                # Current player can move to (i-1,j) or (i,j-1)
                # If either move leads to a losing position for the opponent, current player can win
                can_win = False
                if i > 0 and dp[i-1][j] == 0:
                    can_win = True
                if j > 0 and dp[i][j-1] == 0:
                    can_win = True
                dp[i][j] = 1 if can_win else 0

            x = int(input[ptr])
            y = int(input[ptr + 1])
            ptr += 2
